Leaflet 1.9.4, distributed unchanged from the official npm `leaflet@1.9.4` package.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz
Upstream: https://leafletjs.com/
License: BSD-2-Clause, retained in LICENSE.

Only the browser JS, source map, CSS and images are included. This removes the page's dependency on the unpkg CDN; map tiles remain remote.
